title: Remedies.
bodyText: In enforcing this article, the commissioner shall be entitled to the remedies provided for in section 431:20-103(2), (3), and (4).
bodyHtml: §431:20-123  Remedies.  In enforcing this article, the commissioner shall be entitled to the remedies provided for in section 431:20-103(2), (3), and (4). [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2; am L 2004, c 122, §79]
